cause: UNRESOLVED; unchanged path/source and timeout returned do not establish cause or prove pre-existing failure
decision: One unchanged-source rerun of failed macOS job only. No assertion, timeout, exclusion, source, lock or workflow changes. Original failure remains FAIL. If rerun fails, publication remains blocked; no repeated reruns to obtain a pass.
justification: Bounded check of repeatability of observed elapsed-time failure; historical 0.5.5 release also records an unchanged-source macOS rerun. Passing rerun would establish only that attempt, not a fix or root cause.
